Priya: dropped an update to the rollout detail panel and the compare CTA in Figma: https://figma.com/file/mnop3456 (frames: 'Rollout detail v4', 'Compare CTA variant')

Liam: quick pass 1
Main ask: the 'Compare' CTA sits next to Promote and is visually lightweight; folks keep clicking it by accident. Can we make Promote more prominent and move Compare into a secondary overflow or a small dropdown?

Hana: a11y and copy: 'Compare' alone is ambiguous for screen reader users. Suggest 'Compare versions' and for the dropdown label include aria-expanded state. Also add aria-haspopup="menu" for the overflow.

Omar: contrast: the secondary CTA uses #f7c948 on white and low contrast. Either darken to #d79a00 or add a 1px neutral-600 border. Also add an icon + text so target size is clearer.

Kei: microcopy: Promote -> 'Promote to production', Confirm -> 'Confirm promote' (then add the percentage and commit id in the confirmation copy). For Compare, show a short tooltip 'Compare runtime metrics and diffs' so people know what it opens.

Priya: UX decision proposal: make Promote primary (solid), move Compare into a chevron menu with items: 'Compare versions', 'Open diff view', 'Create rollback proposal'. Keep Compare visible but one click lower.

Liam: keyboard shortcut note: add 'C' to open Compare when focus is on a version row, but require focus-visible and a tooltip hint. Add this to keyboard shortcuts modal.

Hana: screen reader behavior: when the overflow menu opens, move focus into the first menu item and announce 'Menu opened: Compare actions'. Use role=menu and role=menuitem. For the Promote confirmation, ensure the modal has aria-labelledby and role=dialog.

Omar: animation/accessibility: when the Promote button is pressed and toast appears allow a 20s undo. show a subtle progress bar in the toast for sighted users and visually-hidden text for screen readers like 'Undo available for 20 seconds'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the progress animation.

Priya: recap: Promote becomes primary solid button + updated copy, Compare moves to overflow with clearer copy, contrast bumped (darker amber or 1px border), added icon+text for CTA, 'C' shortcut for compare, menu focus management and ARIA roles, 20s undo toast with progress bar + reduced-motion support. I'll update Figma and post new frames by EOD.

Kei: small follow-up: add commit short id in the header next to version name (e.g., v45 • abc123) so the confirm modal can pull that string easily.
